Our store is open from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Monday through Saturday. Sunday hours are 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Our main flagship store is located at 123 Retail Ave, Suite 100, New York, NY 10001.
We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused items in their original packaging. Please bring your receipt or order confirmation.
To track your order, please log into your account and view the orders page, or provide your order ID to our support agent.
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal. Cash is accepted in stores.
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. International shipping takes 7-14 business days.
Standard shipping is free for all orders over $50. Otherwise, standard shipping is $4.99 and express is $9.99.
